title: VistaVLA: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware 3D Gaussian-Grounded VLA for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful end-to-end paradigm for robotic manipulation by mapping language instructions and 2D visual inputs directly to actions. However, these models lack an explicit, scene-level 3D representation, limiting their ability to reason over spatial layouts and geometric constraints. While recent efforts incorporate explicit 3D cues, such as depth maps or point clouds, to improve geometric awareness, they primarily capture low-level structures and lack high-level semantic grounding in 3D space. In human cognition, interaction with the physical world relies on a 3D semantic cognitive map - an internal mental model that integrates spatial layouts with semantic context to enable persistent, viewpoint-invariant reasoning. In light of this, we present VistaVLA, a novel two-stage framework that constructs a geometry- and semantics-aware 3D cognitive representation from 3D Gaussian primitives and grounds it as compact context tokens for VLA policy learning. Specifically, VistaVLA lifts multi-view vision-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, forming geometry-anchored semantic tokens that align view-consistent spatial grounding with 2D visual feature spaces. To make this 3D representation computationally tractable for effective VLA control, we introduce Merge-then-Query (MtQ), a token summarization mechanism. MtQ compresses dense Gaussian primitives into a highly compact set of spatially informative tokens, achieving a 99% token reduction while preserving action-relevant 3D layouts and semantic context. Extensive evaluations in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness of VistaVLA. Notably, in real-world scenarios, VistaVLA improves success rates by 22.8% across seven real-world tasks and by 30.0% over the VLA-Adapter baseline on challenging out-of-distribution tasks.
tldr: VistaVLA introduces a two-stage framework that lifts multi-view vision-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, creating geometry- and semantic-aware compact context tokens for VLA policy learning, significantly improving robotic manipulation success rates in both simulated and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: VistaVLA 提出一个两阶段框架，将多视角视觉-语言特征提升为 3D 高斯原语，生成几何与语义感知的紧凑上下文令牌用于 VLA 策略学习，在仿真和真实环境中显著提升机器人操作成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将语言指令和二维视觉输入直接映射为动作，已成为机器人操作中强大的端到端范式。然而，这些模型缺乏显式的场景级三维表示，限制了其在空间布局和几何约束方面的推理能力。尽管近期研究通过整合深度图或点云等显式三维线索来增强几何感知能力，但这些方法主要捕获低级结构，缺乏三维空间中高级语义的语义基础。在人类认知中，与物理世界的交互依赖于三维语义认知地图——一种将空间布局与语义上下文相融合的内部心智模型，能够实现持久且视角不变的推理。基于此，我们提出VistaVLA——一种新颖的两阶段框架，该框架从三维高斯基元中构建兼具几何与语义感知的三维认知表征，并将其压缩为用于VLA策略学习的紧凑上下文令牌。具体而言，VistaVLA将多视角视觉-语言特征提升至三维高斯基元，形成几何锚定的语义令牌，从而将视角一致的空间基元与二维视觉特征空间对齐。为使该三维表征在计算上适用于高效VLA控制，我们引入令牌摘要机制——Merge-then-Query（MtQ）。MtQ将密集的高斯基元压缩为一组高度紧凑且包含空间信息的令牌，在保留动作相关的三维布局与语义上下文的同时实现99%的令牌压缩率。在模拟与真实环境中的广泛评估验证了VistaVLA的有效性。值得注意的是，真实场景实验显示，VistaVLA在七项真实世界任务中平均成功率提升22.8%，在具有挑战性的分布外任务中较VLA-Adapter基线提升30.0%。

title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning holds great promise for improving robot policies beyond the limits of imitation learning. However, its practical adoption remains bottlenecked by the lack of reliable vision-language reward models that provide dense and informative feedback. Two key challenges remain: acquiring diverse failure data at scale and obtaining fine-grained reward signals beyond sparse trajectory-level success labels. Collecting failure trajectories typically requires laborious human effort, while pseudo-failures constructed by relabeling successful demonstrations fail to capture the diverse physical failure modes that arise during robot execution. Meanwhile, existing reward models often predict sparse binary or trajectory-level rewards, which provide limited guidance for efficient policy optimization. We introduce DenseReward, a dense robotic reward model that addresses both challenges. To train DenseReward, we develop an automated failure data generation pipeline that synthesizes physically realistic failure trajectories in simulation without human labeling, covering diverse failure modes such as collisions, missed grasps, object drops, and recovery behaviors. DenseReward predicts dense frame-level reward scores from visual observations and language instructions, enabling fine-grained estimation of task progress throughout an episode. Experiments show that DenseReward outperforms general-purpose VLMs and existing robotic reward models in dense reward prediction across both simulated and real-world manipulation. We further demonstrate that DenseReward provides effective reward guidance for downstream model predictive control and reinforcement learning. We release the dataset, trained reward models, and evaluation suite to support the development of failure-aware dense reward modeling for robot learning.
tldr: DenseReward introduces an automated pipeline to synthesize diverse failure trajectories in simulation and trains a dense frame-level reward model from vision and language, outperforming existing reward models for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: DenseReward 提出了一种自动化流程，在仿真中合成多样的失败轨迹，并训练了一个基于视觉和语言的密集帧级奖励模型，在机器人操作任务中优于现有奖励模型。
summary_zh: 强化学习在提升机器人策略方面具有超越模仿学习的巨大潜力，但其实际应用仍受限于缺乏能提供密集且信息丰富反馈的可靠视觉语言奖励模型。两个关键挑战依然存在：大规模获取多样化的失败数据，以及获得超越稀疏轨迹级成功标签的细粒度奖励信号。收集失败轨迹通常需要耗费大量人力，而通过重新标注成功演示构建的伪失败样本无法捕捉机器人执行过程中出现的多样化物理失效模式。同时，现有奖励模型通常预测稀疏的二值或轨迹级奖励，这为高效策略优化提供的指导十分有限。我们提出DenseReward——一种密集机器人奖励模型，该模型同时应对上述两大挑战。为训练DenseReward，我们开发了自动化失败数据生成流水线，无需人工标注即可在仿真中合成物理真实的失败轨迹，涵盖碰撞、抓取失败、物体掉落及恢复行为等多种失效模式。DenseReward能从视觉观察和语言指令中预测密集的逐帧奖励分数，从而实现对整轮任务进度的细粒度估计。实验表明，在仿真与现实操作场景的密集奖励预测任务中，DenseReward均优于通用视觉语言模型及现有机器人奖励模型。我们进一步证明DenseReward能为下游模型预测控制与强化学习提供有效奖励引导。我们开源了数据集、预训练奖励模型及评估套件，以支持面向机器人学习的故障感知密集奖励模型的发展。

title: TerraZero: Procedural Driving Simulation for Zero-Demonstration Self-Play at Scale
summary: Training robust autonomous driving agents requires a simulator that is fast enough for reinforcement learning at scale, realistic enough to ground behavior in real-world map structure, and diverse enough to cover the safety-critical long tail that logged data rarely contains. We present TerraZero, a procedural driving simulator and self-play training stack. A configurable C engine runs simulation on the CPU and policy inference on the GPU over a zero-copy path, sustaining 1.3M agent-steps per second on a single server-grade GPU, far faster than existing object-level simulators, while keeping fidelity lighter single-agent systems omit: heterogeneous agents, multiple dynamics models, and full traffic-rule enforcement. TerraZero treats logged data only as a source of real-world map geometry, populating each map with randomized rule-based road users and signal controllers and randomizing agent dynamics, rewards, and sizes per episode, so a map yields an unbounded set of scenarios. Every reported policy trains from scratch by reinforcement learning alone on a compute-efficient self-play recipe across GPUs, with zero human demonstrations and no fallback planner at inference. Policies generalize zero-shot across cities and datasets, including emergent left-hand-traffic driving without explicit supervision. As an ego policy, TerraZero is the first fully learned policy to top the InterPlan long-tail benchmark, ahead of larger learned planners; on routine-driving val14 it ranks among the best approaches and is the safest, posting the best collision and time-to-collision scores. On Waymo Open Sim Agents realism the same recipe outperforms other demonstration-free methods and is competitive with the strongest reference-anchored self-play method. One stack serves both roles: driving policies across dynamics for cars and trucks, and sim agents that jointly control vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists.
tldr: TerraZero is a fast, procedural driving simulator that enables zero-demonstration self-play training of RL policies, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the InterPlan long-tail benchmark and the Waymo Open Sim Agents realism benchmark.
tldr_zh: TerraZero是一个快速、程序化生成的驾驶模拟器，支持零演示的自博弈训练，在InterPlan长尾基准和Waymo开放模拟智能体真实性基准上达到了最先进性能。
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
训练鲁棒的自动驾驶智能体需要满足三个条件的模拟器：足够快以支持大规模强化学习，足够真实以将行为锚定于现实世界地图结构，以及足够多样以覆盖记录数据中罕见的安全关键长尾场景。我们提出TerraZero——一个程序化驾驶模拟器与自我对弈训练框架。可配置的C引擎在CPU上运行仿真，同时通过零拷贝路径在GPU上执行策略推理，在单块服务器级GPU上每秒可维持130万智能体步数，远超现有对象级模拟器，同时保留了轻量级单智能体系统所忽略的保真度：异质智能体、多种动力学模型以及完整交通规则执行。TerraZero仅将记录数据作为现实地图几何信息的来源，通过基于规则的随机化道路使用者与信号控制器填充每个地图，并在每轮回合中随机化智能体动力学、奖励函数及尺寸，从而每个地图可生成无限场景集。所有报告的策略均完全通过强化学习在跨GPU的计算高效自我对弈方案中从零训练，无需任何人类演示，推理时也无备用规划器。策略可零样本泛化至不同城市与数据集，包括在无显式监督下涌现左侧通行驾驶行为。作为自车策略，TerraZero成为首个在InterPlan长尾基准测试中登顶的完全学习型策略，超越规模更大的学习规划器；在常规驾驶数据集val14上，其位列最优方法并实现最佳安全性，取得最优碰撞得分与碰撞时间得分。在Waymo Open Sim Agents真实性评估中，同一方案优于其他无演示方法，并与最强的参考锚定自我对弈方法竞争。单套框架可同时承担两种角色：适用于汽车与卡车的跨动力学驾驶策略，以及联合控制车辆、行人、骑行者的仿真智能体。

title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are able to leverage pretrained video generators for both world modeling and action prediction. However, directly leveraging such video generators for control raises a new challenge: how to represent actions in a suitable form that aligns with pretrained video generators while carrying enough motion cues for accurate control. Existing numerical actions fail to satisfy the former, and prior visual action representations overlook the temporal motion structure across frames. We address this issue with FlowWAM, a dual-stream diffusion framework that adopts optical flow as a unified, video-native action representation. Flow videos share the same format as RGB videos and encode rich per-pixel displacement. By jointly modeling them within a shared pretrained video generator, FlowWAM can naturally implement two modes of WAMs. In policy mode, FlowWAM generates flow for action prediction, while in world-model mode, it uses target flow sequences to guide future video generation. Moreover, since flow can be easily extracted from raw videos without action labels, FlowWAM can leverage large-scale action-unlabeled video datasets for pretraining. We empirically find that our flow-based action representation delivers gains across both modes. On RoboTwin manipulation, FlowWAM raises the success rate to 92.94% on the Clean setting and 92.14% on Random, outperforming both VLA and WAM baselines. On WorldArena world modeling, it achieves the best overall EWMScore (63.71) with an 18.4% relative improvement in trajectory accuracy. More results can be found on our project website: https://flow-wam.github.io .
tldr: FlowWAM introduces optical flow as a unified video-native action representation for World Action Models, enabling a dual-stream diffusion framework that jointly models flow and RGB for both policy (action prediction) and world-model (future video generation) modes.
tldr_zh: FlowWAM 提出将光流作为世界动作模型的统一视频原生动作表示，通过双流扩散框架联合建模光流和 RGB，实现策略模式（动作预测）和世界模型模式（未来视频生成）。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）能够利用预训练的视频生成器同时进行世界建模与动作预测。然而，直接利用此类视频生成器进行控制带来了新的挑战：如何以与预训练视频生成器兼容的形式表示动作，同时携带足够的运动线索以实现精确控制。现有的数值化动作无法满足前者要求，而先前的视觉动作表示则忽略了跨帧的时间运动结构。我们通过FlowWAM——一种采用光流作为统一、原生视频动作表示的双流扩散框架——解决了这一问题。光流视频与RGB视频具有相同格式，并编码了丰富的逐像素位移。通过在共享的预训练视频生成器中对两者进行联合建模，FlowWAM能够自然实现WAM的两种模式。在策略模式下，FlowWAM生成光流用于动作预测；而在世界模型模式下，它利用目标光流序列引导未来视频的生成。此外，由于无需动作标签即可从原始视频中轻松提取光流，FlowWAM能够利用大规模无动作标签的视频数据集进行预训练。我们的实验发现，基于光流的动作表示在两种模式下均能带来性能提升。在RoboTwin操作任务中，FlowWAM在Clean环境下将成功率提升至92.94%，在Random环境下达到92.14%，优于VLA和WAM基线方法。在世界模型评估平台WorldArena上，它取得了最佳总体环境世界模型得分（EWMScore，63.71），其中轨迹准确率相对提升18.4%。更多结果请访问项目网站：https://flow-wam.github.io。

title: ChunkFlow: Towards Continuity-Consistent Chunked Policy Learning
summary: Vision-language action (VLA) models increasingly adopt chunked action heads to satisfy real-time constraints; however, this introduces boundary jitter: overlapping regions between consecutive chunks often yield inconsistent predictions, degrading temporal coherence and the task success rate. Existing methods, such as inference-time blending, merely reweight mismatched proposals without correcting underlying errors, leading to residual accumulation under biased or noisy histories. We propose ChunkFlow, a seam-aware training-and-execution framework for chunked policies that aligns chunk structure with boundary execution. It partitions each chunk into frozen, editable, and future zones, applies deterministic overlap blending at execution, and trains raw predictions with seam and first- and second-order continuity losses. History corruption and scheduled sampling improve robustness to executed-history errors, while an AWAC fine-tuning stage adapts the policy without removing these structural regularizers. Under mild smoothness assumptions, pre-blending seam discrepancies provably decay with increasing overlap. Experiments on CALVIN, LIBERO, and real robots show an improved success-stability trade-off with low-latency inference. Project page: https://cytoderm-ai.github.io/chunkflow.
tldr: ChunkFlow proposes a seam-aware training-and-execution framework with continuity losses and history corruption to eliminate boundary jitter in chunked VLA policies, improving temporal coherence and success rate on real robots.
tldr_zh: ChunkFlow 提出了一种感知缝的训练与执行框架，通过连续性损失和历史破坏消除分片VLA策略中的边界抖动，提升了时间一致性和真实机器人上的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言动作（VLA）模型日益采用分块动作头以满足实时性约束；然而，这引入了边界抖动问题：连续分块之间的重叠区域往往产生不一致的预测，降低了时间连贯性和任务成功率。现有方法（如推理时混合）仅对失配提案重新加权而不修正底层误差，导致在有偏或含噪声的历史条件下产生残差累积。我们提出ChunkFlow，一种面向分块策略的接缝感知训练-执行框架，使分块结构与边界执行对齐。该框架将每个分块划分为冻结区、可编辑区和未来区，在执行时应用确定性重叠混合，并通过接缝损失及一阶、二阶连续性损失训练原始预测。历史损坏与计划采样增强了对已执行历史误差的鲁棒性，而AWAC微调阶段在不移除这些结构正则化项的情况下自适应调整策略。在适度光滑性假设下，预混合接缝差值随重叠增加可证明地衰减。在CALVIN、LIBERO及真实机器人上的实验表明，该方法实现了低延迟推理下成功率与稳定性的优化权衡。项目页面：https://cytoderm-ai.github.io/chunkflow。

title: MAMMOTH: A Multi-Modal End-to-End Policy for Off-Road Mobility Robust to Missing Modality
summary: Reliable autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments remains a critical unsolved challenge due to extreme terrain diversity, drastic illumination variations and acute sensor degradation. Recent developments have approached the problem as a traversability costmap estimation or visual navigation task. However, many exhibit heavy reliance on RGB modality, leading to poor performance in varied illumination such as glares, shadows or low ambient light. Achieving robust generalization in such conditions requires integrating modalities that provide supplementary scene information. Such multi-modal methods suffer from a rigid dependency on the presence of near-perfect sensor inputs, leaving them unable to robustly handle sensor degradation or individual modality failure. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMMOTH (MAsking Multi-Modal inputs for Off-road Traversability Heuristic-informed navigation), a unified end-to-end navigation policy for robust off-road visual-goal-conditioned navigation and undirected exploration. Specifically, MAMMOTH efficiently fuses multi-modal observations (RGB, Thermal, 3D Pointcloud and Ego Velocity) and is trained with a modality dropout scheme, enabling it to generalize to missing modalities at inference time. Furthermore, we employ a diffusion policy to learn the joint conditional probability distribution of physically-grounded trajectories and a intrinsic traversability heuristic. MAMMOTH utilizes this heuristic to prefer safer, smoother trajectories. We validate MAMMOTH through extensive real-world robot experiments in distinct off-road environments, including night-time operation. Our results demonstrate superior performance, with significant improvements in collision avoidance, terrain-aware planning and generalization to missing modalities. The code and dataset used for this work will be made publicly available.
tldr: MAMMOTH is an end-to-end multi-modal navigation policy for off-road robots that uses a modality dropout training scheme and a diffusion policy to robustly handle missing sensor inputs and improve traversability and collision avoidance.
tldr_zh: MAMMOTH 是一种用于越野机器人的端到端多模态导航策略，通过模态随机丢弃训练方案和扩散策略，鲁棒地处理缺失传感器输入并提升通过性与避碰能力。
summary_zh: 在非结构化越野环境中实现可靠自主导航仍是一项尚未攻克的重大挑战，其难点源于极端地形多样性、剧烈光照变化以及传感器性能严重退化等问题。近期研究多将该问题建模为可通行性代价地图估计或视觉导航任务，但其中许多方法过度依赖RGB模态信息，导致在眩光、阴影或低环境光等复杂光照条件下表现不佳。要在此类环境中实现稳健泛化，需整合能提供补充场景信息的多种模态。然而，这类多模态方法存在对近乎完美传感器输入的刚性依赖，因而无法有效应对传感器退化或单一模态故障。为突破这些限制，我们提出MAMMOTH（面向越野可通行性启发式导航的多模态输入掩码框架）——一种面向越野视觉目标导向导航与无向探索的统一端到端导航策略。具体而言，MAMMOH高效融合多模态观测数据（RGB、热成像、三维点云及自车速度），并通过模态丢弃机制进行训练，使其能在推理阶段泛化至缺失模态场景。此外，我们采用扩散策略学习物理可行轨迹与内在可通行性启发式的联合条件概率分布。MAMMOH利用该启发式优先选择更安全、更平滑的轨迹。我们在不同越野环境（含夜间作业）中通过大量真实机器人实验验证了MAMMOH性能。结果表明，该方法在碰撞规避、地形感知规划及缺失模态泛化方面均实现显著提升，并展现出卓越性能。本研究所用代码与数据集将对外公开。

title: ExToken: Structured Exploration for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated significant potential for improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on complex manipulation tasks. However, its practical scalability remains severely limited by the substantial cost of environmental interactions. In this work, we first investigate the exploration stagnation bottleneck in current VLA-RL frameworks and reveal that trajectory diversity is fundamentally more important to sample efficiency than the sheer quantity of collected rollouts. Motivated by these insights, we introduce RL Exploration Token (ExToken), a simple yet general framework that condition VLA policies on discrete behavioral priors derived from offline demonstrations for structured exploration. By conditioning the policy on different tokens during rollout collection, ExToken encourages the agent to explore diverse behavioral modes, substantially improving state-action coverage and exploration efficiency. To bridge exploration during training with deterministic inference at deployment, ExToken further incorporates a state-conditioned token selector that adaptively predicts effective behavioral modes for unseen scenarios. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ExToken consistently accelerates convergence, improves task performance, and exhibits strong robustness under highly constrained interaction budgets.
tldr: This paper proposes ExToken, a framework that conditions VLA policies on discrete behavioral tokens from offline demonstrations to enable structured exploration, improving sample efficiency and task performance in robotic manipulation RL fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ExToken框架，通过将VLA策略条件化于离线演示中的离散行为令牌，实现结构化探索，从而提升机器人操作RL微调中的样本效率和任务性能。
summary_zh: 强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL）在提升视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）模型执行复杂操作任务方面展现出显著潜力。然而，其实际可扩展性因环境交互的高昂成本而受到严重制约。本研究首先探究了当前VLA-RL框架中的探索停滞瓶颈，揭示出轨迹多样性对样本效率的影响本质上比采集的rollout数量更为关键。基于此发现，我们提出RL探索令牌（ExToken）——一种简洁通用的框架，通过将VLA策略条件化为源自离线演示的离散行为先验，实现结构化探索。通过在rollout收集中对不同令牌施加条件约束，ExToken引导智能体探索多样化的行为模式，显著提升状态-动作覆盖范围与探索效率。为弥合训练时的探索机制与部署时确定性推理之间的鸿沟，ExToken进一步引入状态条件令牌选择器，可自适应预测未知场景中的有效行为模式。在模拟与真实机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，ExToken能持续加速收敛、提升任务性能，并在高度受限的交互预算下展现出强鲁棒性。

title: PixelLoop: Shortcut Topological Navigation with Pixel-Level Loops
summary: Although topological mapping and navigation have been studied extensively, the specific role and downstream effect of loop closures in purely topological representations has received relatively little attention. Importantly, loop closure over topological maps is distinct from loop closure over globally referenced trajectories and metric maps. Building on recent denser topologies grounded in pixel-level, relative 3D geometry, we propose PixelLoop which introduces loop closures directly in pixel space. Unlike sparse image-level edges or pose-graph corrections in SLAM, our pixel-level closures act as dense topological shortcuts that alter planning connectivity and cost propagation rather than merely aligning coordinates. This dense connectivity enables stable any-point-to-any-point navigation and produces costmaps that align accurately with geometric shortest paths. In particular, we showcase the distinct advantage of applying loop closures to fine-grained pixel topologies rather than image-level topologies. Across extensive simulated experiments, PixelLoop achieves over 35% absolute improvement in both Success Rate and SPL compared to image-relative baselines, with the largest gains in scenarios requiring shortcut exploitation. Results are further validated through real-world mobile robot deployments, demonstrating that dense pixel-level loop closures provide a practical and robust foundation for topological visual navigation. Project Page: https://pixelloop-nav.github.io/
tldr: PixelLoop introduces dense, pixel-level loop closures in topological maps to create shortcuts that improve navigation connectivity and cost-map accuracy, achieving significant gains in success rate and SPL over image-level baselines in both simulation and real-world robot deployments.
tldr_zh: PixelLoop 在拓扑地图中引入了密集的像素级闭环，通过创建捷径来改善导航连通性和成本图精度，在仿真和真实机器人部署中相比图像级基线在成功率和 SPL 上取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 尽管拓扑建图与导航已被广泛研究，但闭环检测在纯拓扑表征中的特定作用及其下游影响却鲜少受到关注。关键在于，拓扑地图上的闭环检测与基于全局参考轨迹及度量地图的闭环检测存在本质差异。基于近期以像素级相对三维几何为根基的稠密拓扑结构，我们提出PixelLoop方法，直接在像素空间中引入闭环检测。与SLAM中稀疏的图像级边或位姿图修正不同，我们的像素级闭环作为稠密拓扑捷径，改变的是规划连通性与成本传播方式，而非单纯对齐坐标。这种稠密连通性支撑起稳定的任意点间导航，并生成与几何最短路径精确对齐的成本地图。我们特别展示了将闭环应用于细粒度像素拓扑（而非图像级拓扑）的独特优势。在大量仿真实验中，相较于图像级基线方法，PixelLoop在成功率与SPL指标上均实现超35%的绝对提升，其中在需利用捷径的场景中增益最为显著。通过真实移动机器人部署的进一步验证，证明稠密像素级闭环能为拓扑视觉导航提供实用且稳健的基础。项目页面：https://pixelloop-nav.github.io/

title: Vision-Based Dribbling for Humanoid Soccer via Privileged Representation Learning
summary: Recent advances in humanoid robotics have highlighted the importance of deployable loco-manipulation skills. Dribbling a soccer ball while evading active opponents requires simultaneous balance, precise ball control, and awareness of a dynamic adversary under onboard sensing and real-time constraints. Existing approaches typically separate perception and motion, which can be effective in controlled settings but may fail under occlusions, fast ball movements, and complex opponent interactions, since perception is not directly optimized for control. We propose an integrated approach in which a temporal depth encoder is embedded into a reinforcement learning policy through a task-specific projection layer. We apply this framework to a simulated Booster T1 humanoid robot and show that it is possible to learn vision-based, opponent-aware dribbling directly from depth observations, without explicit state estimation or privileged scene information. The learned policy achieves 100% success in nominal target-driven dribbling and 96% success with a single static obstacle, while reaching 46% success against an actively moving ball-attacker opponent. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework supports robust vision-based dribbling in nominal and moderately dynamic settings, and provides a strong foundation for handling more challenging moving-adversary scenarios.
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework that integrates a temporal depth encoder into a humanoid robot's dribbling policy via a task-specific projection layer, enabling vision-based, opponent-aware dribbling without explicit state estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种强化学习框架，通过任务特定投影层将时间深度编码器集成到人形机器人运球策略中，实现了无需显式状态估计的、基于视觉且具有对手感知能力的运球。
summary_zh: 近年来，人形机器人领域的进展突显了可部署的移动操作技能的重要性。在躲避活跃对手的同时运球，需要在机载传感和实时约束下实现平衡控制、精确控球以及对动态对手的感知。现有方法通常将感知与运动分离，这在受控环境中可能有效，但在遮挡、快速球运动及复杂对手交互场景下可能失效，因为感知并未直接针对控制进行优化。我们提出一种集成方法，通过任务特定投影层将时间深度编码器嵌入强化学习策略中。将该框架应用于模拟Booster T1人形机器人，结果表明，无需显式状态估计或特权场景信息，即可直接从深度观测中学习基于视觉、感知对手的运球技能。所学策略在标称目标导向运球中达到100%成功率，针对单一静态障碍物达96%成功率，而在面对主动移动的抢球对手时仍实现46%成功率。这些结果表明，所提框架在标称及中等动态场景下支持鲁棒的基于视觉的运球，并为应对更具挑战性的移动对手场景奠定了坚实基础。

title: Jetson-PI: Towards Onboard Real-Time Robot Control via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance on diverse embodied tasks. However, deploying VLA models on low-power onboard devices, such as the Jetson Orin, remains challenging due to their high computational complexity, which leads to substantial inference latency and low control frequency. Asynchronous inference can partially mask this latency by parallelizing action execution and subsequent inference, but it introduces two critical issues: perception-execution misalignment and long reaction time. In this paper, we propose Jetson-PI, a method for efficient VLA deployment on onboard devices via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Correction. To address misalignment, we train a lightweight future correction module that predicts future environment representation conditioned on committed actions, enabling the action expert to directly predict actions from the future time step. To reduce reaction time, we introduce confidence-based scheduling optimization that adaptively balances VLM and action expert invocations, complemented by system-level accelerations including CUDA graph reuse, GPU-resident intermediate buffering, and flow unrolling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Jetson-PI achieves 8.66x and 5.41x improvements in control frequency compared with naive PyTorch and vla.cpp on NVIDIA Jetson Orin, while outperforming VLASH by 14.8\% in average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. The code of our asynchronous algorithm is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI, and our efficient llama.cpp-based inference engine is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI-Edge.
tldr: Jetson-PI proposes foresight-aligned asynchronous correction and confidence-based scheduling to deploy VLA models on low-power onboard devices, achieving significant control frequency improvements and success rate gains on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: Jetson-PI 提出前视对齐异步校正和基于置信度的调度方法，在低功耗机载设备上部署 VLA 模型，显著提升控制频率并在 LIBERO 基准上取得成功率增益。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在多种具身任务中取得了显著性能。然而，在Jetson Orin等低功耗嵌入式设备上部署VLA模型仍面临挑战，因其高计算复杂度会导致严重的推理延迟和低控制频率。异步推理可通过并行执行动作与后续推理来部分掩盖延迟，但会带来两个关键问题：感知-执行失配与长响应时间。本文提出Jetson-PI方法，通过预见对齐的异步校正实现VLA在嵌入式设备上的高效部署。针对失配问题，我们训练了轻量级未来校正模块，该模块基于已提交动作预测未来环境表征，使动作专家能直接从未来时间步预测动作。为降低响应时间，我们引入基于置信度的调度优化，自适应平衡视觉-语言模型与动作专家的调用，并辅以系统级加速策略，包括CUDA图复用、GPU驻留中间缓冲及流程展开。大量实验表明，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin上，Jetson-PI的控制频率较原生PyTorch和vla.cpp分别提升8.66倍和5.41倍，同时在LIBERO基准测试中，其平均成功率较VLASH高出14.8%。我们的异步算法代码已开源至https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI，基于llama.cpp的高效推理引擎已开源至https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI-Edge。

title: TrustVLA: Mechanism-Guided Inference-Time Defense Against Vision-Language-Action Backdoors
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are deployed through pipelines that end users cannot audit, and a poisoned VLA can behave normally on clean observations while a small visual trigger redirects a long-horizon robot policy before any failure becomes observable. Existing vision or language defenses rarely explain what a triggered VLA representation looks like or how to recover behavior without retraining. We study this gap through two independently proposed VLA attacks from groups with distinct injection strategies, BadVLA and INFUSE; the latter persists after downstream clean adaptation. Across the evaluated poisoned models, we identify a recurring internal mechanism: a \emph{compact causal footprint}, namely a small visual support that is attention-seeded, spatially compact, and \emph{causal} in a precise sense -- masking it returns a clean-calibrated evidence-evolution score to the normal operating region. This footprint motivates TrustVLA, a mechanism-guided inference-time defense that adapts the Dirichlet evidence framework from trusted classification to monitor per-token, per-layer epistemic uncertainty in VLA policies. With only a small clean calibration set, TrustVLA (i)~detects abnormal evidence evolution, (ii)~localizes the compact support by counterfactual mechanism-score drop, and (iii)~recovers the observation by localized inpainting. Across OpenVLA/LIBERO and $π_{0.5}$ transfer evaluations, TrustVLA reduces attack success while preserving clean-task performance, providing a retraining-free, mechanism-guided defense for visual-triggered VLA backdoors.
tldr: Proposes TrustVLA, an inference-time defense against visual backdoors in VLA policies, leveraging a compact causal footprint to detect, localize, and recover triggered observations without retraining.
tldr_zh: 提出了TrustVLA，一种针对VLA策略中视觉后门的推理时防御方法，利用紧凑因果足迹检测、定位并恢复被触发的观测，无需重新训练。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过最终用户无法审计的管道进行部署，而受污染的VLA模型在干净观测下可能表现正常，但微小的视觉触发信号会在任何故障变得可观测之前，重定向一个长时域机器人策略。现有的视觉或语言防御方法很少解释触发后的VLA表征呈现何种形态，或如何在不重新训练的情况下恢复行为。本研究通过两个独立提出的VLA攻击——BadVLA和INFUSE（二者采用不同的注入策略）——填补了这一空白；其中INFUSE攻击在后续的干净域适配后仍能持续存在。在被评估的受污染模型中，我们识别出一个重复出现的内部机制：一个**紧凑的因果足迹**，即一个在注意力机制中萌生、空间上紧凑、且在精确意义上具有**因果性**的小型视觉支撑集——屏蔽它将使干净校准后的证据演化分数回归至正常操作区域。这一机制启发我们提出TrustVLA，一种机制引导的推理时防御方法，它将可信分类中的Dirichlet证据框架适配至VLA策略中逐令牌、逐层的认知不确定性监测。仅需少量干净校准集，TrustVLA即可：(i)检测异常证据演化，(ii)通过反事实机制分数下降定位紧凑支撑集，以及(iii)通过局部图像修复恢复观测。在OpenVLA/LIBERO及π₀.₅迁移评估中，TrustVLA在保持干净任务性能的同时降低了攻击成功率，为视觉触发的VLA后门提供了一种无需重新训练、机制引导的防御方法。

title: Reducing Temporal Redundancy for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit strong generalization for robotic manipulation, yet their high inference latency limits real time deployment. We identify two primary sources of temporal redundancy in existing VLA pipelines: repeated visual encoding of highly similar consecutive frames and multi step iterative sampling in diffusion based policies. To address this, we propose a system level acceleration strategy that reduces computation in both perception and action generation. On the perception side, we incrementally update only tokens corresponding to dynamic scene regions instead of re-encoding entire frames. On the policy side, we compress diffusion sampling into a compact 2-step schedule through efficiency oriented training while preserving action precision. Experiments on Libero, RobotWin, and Real Robot Platforms demonstrate over 2 times speedup while maintaining high performance, achieving up to 98% success rate on general manipulation benchmarks. Our codes will be released on Github.
tldr: This paper proposes a system-level acceleration strategy for VLA models that reduces temporal redundancy by incrementally updating dynamic visual tokens and using a compact 2-step diffusion schedule, achieving over 2x speedup on real robot platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种针对VLA模型的系统级加速策略，通过增量更新动态场景令牌和压缩扩散采样步骤，在真实机器人平台上实现2倍以上加速。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力，但其高推理延迟限制了实时部署。我们识别出现有VLA流程中时间冗余的两个主要来源：对高度相似连续帧的重复视觉编码，以及基于扩散策略的多步迭代采样。针对这一问题，我们提出一种系统级加速策略，在感知和动作生成两个环节均减少计算量。在感知侧，我们仅增量更新动态场景区域对应的令牌，而非重新编码完整帧。在策略侧，我们通过面向效率的训练将扩散采样压缩为紧凑的两步调度，同时保持动作精度。在Libero、RobotWin及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，该方法在保持高性能的同时实现了2倍以上的加速，在通用操作基准测试中成功率达98%。相关代码将发布于GitHub。

title: GaitSpan: Growing Humanoid Locomotion from Walking to Running
summary: A humanoid that can walk should not relearn locomotion from scratch to jog or run. Yet current approaches often obtain gait diversity by prescribing gait schedules, imitating motion clips, training experts to switch between or distilling skills into one policy. These strategies can produce impressive behaviors, but offer limited flexibility across continuous speed commands, terrains, and morphologies. We study skill growth with GaitSpan, a framework that expands a pretrained, basic walking policy into faster locomotion. It treats walking as a seed skill: reusable motor structure for balance, support, body coordination, and contact transition that can be regenerated at new rhythms, extended into longer/higher strides, and corrected by residual adaptation. This expansion has three aspects: 1) rhythm generation, which modulates the frozen walking policy with multiple internal clocks and learns command-conditioned combinations of the resulting canonical actions; 2) stride shaping, which rewards dynamic locomotion patterns appropriate for higher commanded speeds using a physically grounded objective inspired by spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics; and 3) residual adaptation, which captures motion details not accounted for by rhythm generation or stride shaping. GaitSpan is the first to deliver a single command-conditioned humanoid policy that spans walking, jogging, and running-like regimes covering a continuous speed range, transfers across morphologies, and deploys zero-shot on unseen sim-to-sim, and real-world terrains. Compared with baselines either trained with multi-experts or imitation from humans, it learns faster and achieves stronger gait performance.
tldr: GaitSpan expands a pretrained walking policy into faster locomotion (jogging/running) on humanoids via rhythm generation, stride shaping, and residual adaptation, achieving continuous speed command following across morphologies and terrains.
tldr_zh: GaitSpan 通过节奏生成、步幅塑造和残差适应，将预训练的行走策略扩展到更快的运动（慢跑/跑步），实现了跨形态和地形的连续速度指令跟随。
summary_zh: 一个能够行走的仿人机器人不应从零开始重新学习运动模式才能实现慢跑或奔跑。然而，当前的方法通常通过预设步态时间表、模仿运动片段、训练专家策略进行切换或将其技能提炼为单一策略来获得步态多样性。这些策略虽能产生令人印象深刻的行为，但在连续速度指令、地形和形态变化上的灵活性有限。我们通过GaitSpan框架研究技能增长，该框架将预训练的基础行走策略扩展到更快的运动模式。它将行走视为种子技能：一种可复用的运动结构，涵盖平衡、支撑、身体协调和触地转换，能够在新的节奏下再生，扩展为更长/更高的步幅，并通过残差适应进行修正。这种扩展包含三个方面：1) 节奏生成——通过多个内部时钟调制冻结的行走策略，学习指令条件下组合产生的典型动作；2) 步幅塑造——利用基于弹簧负载倒立摆动力学的物理驱动目标，奖励适合更高指令速度的动态运动模式；3) 残差适应——捕捉节奏生成或步幅塑造未涵盖的运动细节。GaitSpan首次实现了一个单一指令条件的仿人策略，可覆盖步行、慢跑和奔跑等连续速度范围，跨形态迁移，并在未见过的模拟-模拟及真实世界地形上实现零样本部署。与基于多专家训练或人类模仿的基线方法相比，它学习速度更快，步态性能更强。

title: Robust In-Hand Manipulation via Priors in Reinforcement Learning and Mechanical Design
summary: In-hand manipulation without external sensing is challenging due to uncertainties from finger-object contacts and disturbances by gravity. While reinforcement learning has shown promise in learning complex finger gaiting, existing approaches do not prioritize maintaining well-conditioned grasps for sustained manipulation. We introduce two complementary physics priors for robust in-hand rolling: a global grasp-quality prior derived from classical grasp analysis and a local contact-geometry prior based on fingertip curvature. The grasp-quality prior is used as a dense reward-shaping term that encourages well-distributed contacts with improved worst-case wrench resistance. The contact-geometry prior is expressed in the fingertip geometry that mechanically shapes the contact interface toward task-aligned rolling while reducing off-axis drift. We evaluate the effect of these priors on learning in-hand rolling manipulation for a multifingered robotic hand manipulating three different objects at four palm orientations. Results show significant improvement in rotation efficiency, grasp stability, and disturbance rejection, suggesting that physics priors embedded in both learning and fingertip morphology improve task robustness and sim-to-real transfer. An overview video can be found at https://youtu.be/pdd1wHxQnJM?si=dM-U5kiiPTYsk3Pk.
tldr: This paper introduces two physics priors—a grasp-quality prior from classical analysis and a contact-geometry prior from fingertip shape—to improve reinforcement learning for robust in-hand rolling manipulation, demonstrating enhanced rotation efficiency, grasp stability, and disturbance rejection on a multifingered hand.
tldr_zh: 本文引入两种物理先验——来自经典分析的抓取质量先验和来自指尖形状的接触几何先验——来改进强化学习以实现稳健的掌上滚动操作，在多指手上展示了更好的旋转效率、抓取稳定性和抗干扰能力。
summary_zh: 由于指-物接触的不确定性以及重力带来的干扰，无外部传感条件下的手中操作极具挑战性。尽管强化学习在掌握复杂手指步态方面展现出潜力，但现有方法并未优先考虑维持良好条件化的抓取以实现持续操作。我们针对稳健的手中滚动操作引入两种互补的物理先验：一种源自经典抓取分析的全局抓取质量先验，以及一种基于指尖曲率的局部接触几何先验。其中，抓取质量先验用作密集奖励塑形项，鼓励形成分布均匀的接触并提升最差情况下的抗力矩能力。接触几何先验则通过指尖几何形态表达，从力学层面将接触界面塑形为与任务对齐的滚动模式，同时减少离轴漂移。我们评估了这些先验对多指机器人手学习手中滚动操作的影响——该手以四种掌心方向操控三种不同物体。结果表明，旋转效率、抓取稳定性和抗干扰能力均显著提升，表明嵌入学习过程与指尖形态的物理先验能够增强任务鲁棒性及仿真到现实的迁移。概述视频请见：https://youtu.be/pdd1wHxQnJM?si=dM-U5kiiPTYsk3Pk。

title: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
summary: Building capable embodied agents requires not only multimodal perception and understanding, but also agentic capabilities for reasoning about actions, adapting to evolving situations, and interacting with the physical world. In this report, we introduce Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an efficient and powerful embodied foundation model specifically designed for embodied agents operating in the physical world. To cultivate such capabilities from the pre-training stage onward, we define an action-centric capability taxonomy comprising three progressive dimensions: Action-Relevant State Understanding, Action-Transition Reasoning, and Sequential and Adaptive Reasoning. Guided by this taxonomy, we develop a systematic data pipeline and curate data mixtures spanning both pre-training and post-training. To deliver strong physical-world understanding and interaction capabilities while supporting latency-sensitive deployment, we build our model on the Hy3-A3B language backbone and the Hy-ViT2 vision encoder. Its efficient Mixture-of-Experts architecture combines strong model capacity with high inference efficiency. We evaluate Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 on a comprehensive suite of 38 benchmarks covering embodied perception, physical-world understanding, and embodied reasoning. The model achieves the best performance among similarly sized models on 19 of the 38 benchmarks and substantially outperforms strong competitors, including Qwen3.6-A3B and Cosmos 3. Compared with the previous-generation Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 improves average performance by 8.4%. Despite activating only 3B parameters, it achieves performance close to that of the previous-generation model with 32B activated parameters. Beyond static benchmark evaluation, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 also demonstrates strong performance on embodied agentic tasks requiring multi-turn interaction and long-horizon reasoning.
tldr: This paper introduces Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an efficient Mixture-of-Experts embodied foundation model designed for physical-world agents, achieving strong performance on 38 benchmarks while activating only 3B parameters.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0，一个高效的混合专家架构具身基础模型，专为物理世界智能体设计，在激活仅3B参数的情况下在38个基准测试中取得强劲性能。
summary_zh: 构建具有能力的具身智能体不仅需要多模态感知与理解能力，还需要具备行动推理、适应动态变化环境以及与物理世界交互的智能体能力。本报告提出Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0，一种专为物理世界具身智能体设计的高效大型具身基础模型。为从预训练阶段开始培养此类能力，我们定义了以行动为核心的能力分类体系，包含三个递进维度：行动相关状态理解、行动转换推理，以及序列与自适应推理。基于该分类体系，我们开发了系统化数据管道，并构建了覆盖预训练与后训练阶段的数据混合方案。为在支持延迟敏感部署的同时提供强大的物理世界理解与交互能力，模型采用Hy3-A3B语言骨干网络与Hy-ViT2视觉编码器。其高效的混合专家架构兼具强大的模型能力与高推理效率。我们在涵盖具身感知、物理世界理解与具身推理的38项基准测试中评估了Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0。该模型在38项基准测试中的19项上达到同等规模模型最优性能，并显著超越强竞争模型（包括Qwen3.6-A3B与Cosmos 3）。与上一代Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B相比，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0平均性能提升8.4%。尽管仅激活30亿参数，其性能已接近上一代激活320亿参数的模型。除静态基准测试外，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0在需要多轮交互与长程推理的具身智能任务中同样展现出强劲性能。

title: ReflectVLN: Training Vision-Language Navigation Agents with Reflective Reasoning
summary: Existing vision-language navigation methods often couple a VLM with waypoint decoders to produce multi-step action plans, but they typically lack an explicit closed-loop mechanism for tracking semantic progress, diagnosing execution failures, and recovering from error accumulation in long-horizon navigation. To address this gap, we propose ReflectVLN, an agentic VLN framework that organizes decision-making through bidirectionally interactive intention and execution agents. The intention agent performs subtask decomposition and reflection, generating executable subtask descriptions as corrective plans. Conditioned on these descriptions, the execution agent grounds them into short-horizon actions under current observations while monitoring sub-goal progress and detecting off-track behavior. Crucially, ReflectVLN enables closed-loop bidirectional communication: the execution agent emits progress and deviation signals to trigger reflection and subtask updates on demand, and the intention agent returns structured guidance that reconditions subsequent actions for recovery. To encourage temporally coherent decisions with interpretable intermediate rationales, we introduce Action Chain-of-Thought (Action-CoT), a path-conditioned dual-query training scheme for action generation. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks show that ReflectVLN improves success rates and path efficiency under a constrained data budget, with favorable training cost and fewer high-level intention calls at inference time, while providing interpretable intermediate decisions for analysis and collaboration. Code is available at: https://github.com/AIprogrammer/ReflectVLN
tldr: ReflectVLN introduces a closed-loop reflective reasoning framework for vision-language navigation agents, using bidirectionally interactive intention and execution agents with Action Chain-of-Thought to improve success rates and path efficiency.
tldr_zh: ReflectVLN 提出了一种用于视觉语言导航代理的闭环反思推理框架，通过双向交互的意图代理和执行代理以及动作链式思维，提高了成功率和路径效率。
summary_zh: 现有的视觉语言导航方法通常将视觉语言模型与航点解码器结合，以生成多步骤动作规划，但此类方法往往缺乏明确的闭环机制来跟踪语义进度、诊断执行故障，并在长时域导航中从错误累积中恢复。为弥补这一不足，我们提出ReflectVLN——一种通过双向交互的意图智能体与执行智能体组织决策的智能体化视觉语言导航框架。其中，意图智能体负责子任务分解与反思，生成可执行的子任务描述作为修正规划；执行智能体则基于此类描述，在当前观测条件下将其落地为短时域动作，同时监控子目标进度并检测偏离轨迹行为。关键之处在于，ReflectVLN实现了闭环双向通信：执行智能体发出进度与偏离信号，按需触发反思与子任务更新；意图智能体则返回结构化引导，重新生成后续动作以实现恢复。为鼓励具备可解释中间推理过程的时间连贯性决策，我们提出动作思维链（Action-CoT）——一种基于路径条件双查询训练机制的动作生成方案。在标准视觉语言导航基准上的实验表明，ReflectVLN在有限数据预算下提升了成功率与路径效率，其训练成本更低、推理时高层意图调用次数更少，同时提供可解释的中间决策用于分析与协作。代码已开源：https://github.com/AIprogrammer/ReflectVLN

title: DeGuNet: Depth-Guided Ultra-Compact Backbones for Efficient LiDAR-Camera 3D Detection
summary: In autonomous driving perception, the fusion of LiDAR and camera modalities has become the dominant paradigm for 3D object detection. However, current multi-modal frameworks heavily rely on massive visual backbones pretrained on 2D semantic tasks. This reliance introduces substantial parameter redundancy and a structural misalignment, as 2D priors are ill-equipped to handle the extreme sparsity of LiDAR projections required for Bird's-Eye-View geometry. To address this, we present DeGuNet, an ultra-compact and plug-and-play image backbone explicitly designed for depth-guided representation learning. By incorporating sparsity-aware feature extraction mechanisms, DeGuNet effectively aligns multi-view images with unstructured LiDAR depth while strictly preventing invalid-region contamination. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate DeGuNet's broad plug-and-play applicability and superior efficiency. When integrated into established baselines, it fundamentally eliminates architectural redundancy, reducing GPU memory consumption by up to 66.5% and achieving a 1.16x inference speedup. Concurrently, DeGuNet delivers up to a 6.20 absolute mAP gain, establishing a new paradigm for parameter-efficient multi-modal 3D perception.
tldr: DeGuNet introduces an ultra-compact, depth-guided image backbone for LiDAR-camera 3D detection that eliminates architectural redundancy, reduces GPU memory by up to 66.5%, and achieves significant mAP gains, establishing a new parameter-efficient paradigm for multi-modal autonomous driving perception.
tldr_zh: DeGuNet提出了一种超紧凑、深度引导的图像主干网络，用于激光雷达-相机3D检测，消除架构冗余，减少高达66.5%的GPU内存并实现显著的mAP提升，为多模态自动驾驶感知建立了参数高效的新范式。
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶感知中，激光雷达与摄像头模态的融合已成为三维目标检测的主流范式。然而，当前多模态框架严重依赖在二维语义任务上预训练的大规模视觉主干网络。这种依赖引入了大量参数冗余和结构错位问题，因为二维先验知识难以有效处理鸟瞰图几何中所需的激光雷达投影的极端稀疏性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DeGuNet——一种专为深度引导表征学习设计的超紧凑即插即用图像主干网络。通过引入具备稀疏感知能力的特征提取机制，DeGuNet能够有效对齐多视角图像与非结构化激光雷达深度信息，同时严格防止无效区域污染。在nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明，DeGuNet具有广泛的即插即用适用性和卓越的效率。当集成到现有基线模型中时，它从根本上消除了架构冗余，将GPU内存消耗降低高达66.5%，并实现1.16倍的推理加速。与此同时，DeGuNet的绝对mAP最高提升6.20个百分点，为参数高效的多模态三维感知建立了新范式。

title: Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion with Sparse Attention for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction
summary: Predicting pedestrian crossing intention is a safety-critical task for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches often rely on single-modal inputs or dense multimodal fusion strategies that inadequately capture complementary visual and kinematic information while introducing redundant inter-modal interactions. We propose ADAPT (Adaptive Domain-Aware Pedestrian Crossing Transformer), a multimodal framework that jointly models local and global visual context together with temporal motion dynamics for accurate pedestrian crossing intention prediction. ADAPT processes four spatially aligned visual modalities, including RGB images, local depth maps, global semantic maps, and global depth maps, together with ego-vehicle speed, pedestrian bounding boxes, and skeleton pose information through five specialized modules: a weight-shared Swin Transformer V2 backbone for visual feature extraction, a Cross-Modality Guided Attention module for hierarchical visual fusion, a Mamba-based Motion Feature Encoding module for efficient temporal modeling, a Sparse Cross-Modal Attention module that selectively preserves the most informative inter-modal interactions, and a Vision Transformer-based Temporal Feature Fusion module for sequence-level prediction. Extensive experiments on the JAAD and PIE benchmark datasets demonstrate that ADAPT consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low computational complexity. On JAAD, the proposed method achieves an AUC of 0.73 on JAADbeh and 0.85 on JAADall, while on PIE it achieves an accuracy of 0.92 and an AUC of 0.90. Furthermore, ADAPT performs inference in only 17.23 ms per sample, offering an effective balance between predictive accuracy and real-time deployment efficiency for intelligent transportation and autonomous driving applications.
tldr: Proposes ADAPT, a multimodal transformer with sparse cross-modal attention and Mamba-based temporal encoding for pedestrian crossing intention prediction, achieving SOTA on JAAD and PIE benchmarks with real-time inference.
tldr_zh: 提出ADAPT，一种具有稀疏跨模态注意力和基于Mamba的时间编码的多模态Transformer，用于行人过街意图预测，在JAAD和PIE基准上取得SOTA性能并实现实时推理。
summary_zh: 预测行人过街意图是自动驾驶中的一项安全关键任务，然而现有方法通常依赖单模态输入或密集的多模态融合策略，这些策略在引入冗余跨模态交互的同时，未能充分捕获互补的视觉与运动学信息。我们提出ADAPT（自适应域感知行人过街Transformer），一种多模态框架，通过联合建模局部与全局视觉上下文以及时间运动动态，实现准确的行人过街意图预测。ADAPT处理四种空间对齐的视觉模态——包括RGB图像、局部深度图、全局语义图和全局深度图——并结合自车速度、行人边界框及骨架姿态信息，通过五个专用模块：用于视觉特征提取的权重共享型Swin Transformer V2主干网络、用于分层视觉融合的跨模态引导注意力模块、用于高效时序建模的基于Mamba的运动特征编码模块、选择性保留最具信息量跨模态交互的稀疏跨模态注意力模块，以及基于Vision Transformer的时序特征融合模块实现序列级预测。在JAAD和PIE基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ADAPT在保持低计算复杂度的同时，始终优于现有最先进方法。在JAAD数据集上，本方法在JAADbeh和JAADall上分别达到0.73和0.85的AUC值；在PIE数据集上则实现了0.92的准确率和0.90的AUC值。此外，ADAPT对每个样本仅需17.23毫秒的推理时间，为智能交通与自动驾驶应用提供了预测精度与实时部署效率之间的有效平衡。

title: UR-VC: Unsupervised Robotic Value Correction for Time-Derived Progress Proxies
summary: Modern robot learning systems increasingly rely on dense progress or value signals to evaluate intermediate states, guide policy learning, and detect task completion, making the quality of these signals critical. Since such dense labels are rarely available at scale, normalized time within a demonstration is often used as a scalable substitute: later frames are treated as higher progress. However, this time-derived label is only a noisy proxy for physical task progress. In contact-rich manipulation, a robot may make progress and then lose it through slips, failed grasps, or partial undoing, while the time-derived label continues to increase monotonically. We introduce Unsupervised Robotic Value Correction (UR-VC), an offline, training-free method for correcting time-derived progress labels. UR-VC exploits a simple regularity in demonstration data: similar states often recur across different episodes, but at different timestamps. Instead of trusting the timestamp from a single trajectory, UR-VC retrieves similar states from other episodes and aggregates their time-derived labels to obtain a corrected progress estimate. UR-VC requires no manual progress labels, reward annotations, or additional value model. We evaluate UR-VC on real bimanual cloth flatten-and-fold data, a long-horizon deformable-object manipulation task with visible intermediate progress. The corrected labels capture local regressions and non-uniform progress that normalized time cannot represent, while preserving the overall task trend. We further use the corrected signal to construct advantage labels for VLA training, following recent advantage-conditioned policy learning. UR-VC shows a positive trend in real-robot task success under matched data, model, and training settings.
tldr: Proposes an unsupervised, training-free method to correct noisy time-derived progress labels in robot demonstrations by retrieving and aggregating values from similar states across episodes, improving downstream VLA training.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无监督、免训练的方法，通过跨片段检索相似状态并聚合时间标签来修正机器人演示中由时间推导的进度标签噪声，从而改进下游VLA训练。
summary_zh: 现代机器人学习系统日益依赖密集的进度信号或价值信号来评估中间状态、指导策略学习以及检测任务完成情况，因此这些信号的质量至关重要。由于此类密集标签通常难以大规模获取，演示中的归一化时间常被用作可扩展的替代方案：后续帧被视为具有更高进度。然而，这种基于时间的标签仅是对物理任务进度的有噪代理。在接触密集的操作任务中，机器人可能取得进展后又因滑动、抓取失败或部分撤销而失去进展，而基于时间的标签却持续单调递增。我们提出无监督机器人价值校正（UR-VC），这是一种无需训练、离线修正时间衍生进度标签的方法。UR-VC利用了演示数据中的一个简单规律：相似状态常在不同尝试中重复出现，但时间戳不同。UR-VC不依赖单一轨迹中的时间戳，而是从其他尝试中检索相似状态，并聚合其时间衍生标签以获取修正后的进度估计。UR-VC无需人工标注进度标签、奖励注释或额外价值模型。我们在真实双臂布匹折叠与展平数据（一项具有可见中间进度的长时域可变形物体操作任务）上评估了UR-VC。修正后的标签能够捕捉归一化时间无法表示的局部倒退与非均匀进度，同时保持整体任务趋势。我们进一步将修正后的信号用于构建优势标签，以进行VLA训练，遵循近期基于优势条件的策略学习范式。在匹配的数据、模型和训练设置下，UR-VC在真实机器人任务成功率中展现出积极趋势。

title: Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps for Visual Language Navigation
summary: Visual Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable an embodied agent to navigate complex environments by following natural language instructions. Recent approaches build semantic spatial maps and leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning and decision making. Despite these advances, existing systems lack instance-level object detail and robustness to diverse user queries, limiting reliable navigation in complex indoor environments. To address these limitations, we propose Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps, a unified framework with three key contributions: (1) Instance-level two-and-a-half-dimensional (2.5D) rich information mapping that constructs maps from color and depth observations via open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation, preserving vertical distinctions and capturing small objects, while storing diverse semantic attributes and natural language captions enriched with room-level context. (2) Robust query processing via LLM-based target selection, which dynamically routes queries across type-specialized experts and integrates their outputs through score-level fusion, enabling consistent goal selection across diverse query formulations. (3) Storage-efficient semantic representation that achieves approximately 96% reduction compared to three-dimensional (3D) scene-graph approaches while preserving sufficient spatial information for navigation. The proposed 2.5D representation outperforms the 3D baseline by over 27% in prediction-normalized Area Under the Curve (AUC). In navigation experiments, our method achieves over 17% improvement in object retrieval and over 23% in navigation success compared to the baseline across diverse query types. The project page is available at https://rcilab.github.io/iesm_vln.
tldr: This paper enhances visual language navigation by building 2.5D instance-enriched semantic maps via open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation and using LLM-based query routing for robust goal selection, achieving large compression and strong navigation improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文通过开放词汇全景分割构建2.5D实例丰富的语义地图，并利用基于LLM的查询路由实现稳健的目标选择，从而在视觉语言导航中大幅压缩存储并提升导航性能。
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航（VLN）旨在使具身智能体通过遵循自然语言指令在复杂环境中导航。近期方法构建语义空间地图并利用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行推理与决策。尽管取得进展，现有系统缺乏实例级物体细节以及对多样化用户查询的鲁棒性，限制了复杂室内环境中的可靠导航。为解决这些局限，我们提出实例增强语义地图——一个统一框架，包含三项核心贡献：（1）实例级2.5维丰富信息映射，通过开放词汇全景分割从彩色与深度观测构建地图，保留垂直区分并捕捉小物体，同时存储多样化的语义属性以及融入房间级上下文的自然语言描述；（2）基于LLM目标选择的鲁棒查询处理，通过动态路由查询至类型专精专家并通过分数级融合整合其输出，实现跨多样化查询表述的一致目标选择；（3）存储高效语义表示，相较于三维（3D）场景图方法实现约96%的压缩，同时保留足够用于导航的空间信息。所提出的2.5维表示在预测归一化曲线下面积（AUC）上相较于3D基线提升超过27%。在导航实验中，我们的方法在多样化查询类型下，物体检索成功率提升超过17%，导航成功率相较于基线提升超过23%。项目页面详见https://rcilab.github.io/iesm_vln。

title: Mind the Gap: Promises and Pitfalls of Hierarchical Planning in LeWorldModel
summary: We investigate whether temporal hierarchy can improve LeWorldModel on long-horizon goal-conditioned control. We introduce Hi-LeWM, an extension that freezes the pretrained low-level LeWM and adds high-level planning over latent subgoals. We evaluate Hi-LeWM on PushT and Cube across increasing goal offsets. Hierarchy does not automatically improve performance: at short horizons, the best configuration uses a one-step high-level horizon, while longer horizons reveal a mismatch between the learned high-level action space and the inference-time search distribution. Experiments with true future latent subgoals show that the frozen low-level controller can execute well-aligned intermediate targets, indicating that high-level subgoal generation is the main bottleneck. Unconstrained search can select latent macro-actions that appear favorable under the learned model but produce poor control targets. Constraining search around macro-actions encoded from training trajectories, with appropriate subgoal execution timing, recovers useful hierarchical regimes, improving over flat LeWM by +11.3 percentage points at medium-range horizons and +14.7 percentage points at the longest PushT horizon. Overall, temporal abstraction can benefit compact frozen LeWM, but only when high-level search remains compatible with the low-level controller
tldr: This paper investigates whether adding a temporal hierarchy to LeWorldModel (LeWM) improves long-horizon goal-conditioned control, finding that while hierarchical planning does not automatically help, constraining high-level search with training trajectory macro-actions yields significant improvements over flat LeWM.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了向LeWorldModel（LeWM）添加时间层次结构是否能改善长视野目标条件控制，发现虽然分层规划并非自动有效，但通过约束高层搜索以使用训练轨迹的宏动作，能在平坦LeWM基础上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 我们研究了时间层级结构能否提升LeWorldModel在长时域目标条件控制任务上的表现。为此，我们提出了Hi-LeWM——该扩展模型冻结预训练的低层级LeWM，并引入潜子目标上的高层级规划。我们在PushT和Cube任务上，针对递增的目标偏移量评估了Hi-LeWM。层级结构并不会自动提升性能：在短时域场景下，最优配置采用单步高层级规划；而长时域场景则暴露出学习到的高层级动作空间与推理时的搜索分布之间存在不匹配。利用真实未来潜子目标进行的实验表明，冻结的低层级控制器能够良好执行对齐的中间目标，这说明高层级子目标生成是主要瓶颈。无约束搜索可能选择在所学模型下看似有利的潜宏动作，但实际产生糟糕的控制目标。通过约束搜索范围使其围绕从训练轨迹编码出的宏动作，并配合适当的子目标执行时序，能够恢复有效的层级机制——在PushT任务的中等时域上相比扁平LeWM提升11.3个百分点，在最长的时域上提升14.7个百分点。总体而言，时间抽象对紧凑的冻结LeWM是有益的，但这仅在高层级搜索与低层级控制器保持兼容时才能实现。

title: Model-Based Diffusion Optimal Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning
summary: Multi-Robot Motion Planning in continuous environments, where robots must generate dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories, is challenging due to the combinatorial growth of the joint trajectory space and the difficulty of enforcing dynamic feasibility and hard safety constraints. Recent approaches recast trajectory planning as probabilistic inference, sampling from a posterior over trajectories using diffusion models whose score functions are learned from demonstration data. While showing promising performance, these approaches are limited: they often rely on sizable demonstration datasets and struggle to rigorously enforce dynamics and hard safety constraints during sampling. To this end, we introduce Model-Based Diffusion Optimal Control (MDOC), a model-based diffusion planner that efficiently produces dynamically feasible trajectories without relying on data. Crucially, we show that MDOC's safety mechanism -- combining known dynamics models with Control Barrier Function-constrained projections -- naturally scales to multi-robot planning settings through Conflict-Based Search. Across simulation experiments, this integrated method consistently outperforms representative baseline planners in sample efficiency, geometric smoothness, and success rate, while reducing computation time and producing collision-free trajectories.
tldr: MDOC integrates diffusion-based trajectory generation with model-based safety constraints via Control Barrier Functions and Conflict-Based Search, enabling multi-robot motion planning without reliance on demonstration data.
tldr_zh: MDOC结合了基于扩散模型的轨迹生成与基于控制障碍函数的安全约束，并借助冲突搜索实现多机器人运动规划，无需依赖示范数据。
summary_zh: 摘要：在连续环境中的多机器人运动规划中，机器人必须生成动态可行且无碰撞的轨迹，但由于联合轨迹空间的组合爆炸以及动态可行性与硬安全约束的强制执行困难，这一问题极具挑战性。近期方法将轨迹规划重构为概率推断问题，利用扩散模型从轨迹后验分布中采样，其得分函数从示教数据中学习得到。尽管这些方法展现出令人鼓舞的性能，但仍存在局限性：它们通常依赖大量示教数据集，且难以在采样过程中严格强制执行动力学与硬安全约束。为此，我们提出基于模型的扩散最优控制（MDOC），这是一种无需依赖数据即可高效生成动态可行轨迹的模型驱动扩散规划器。关键在于，我们证明MDOC的安全机制——将已知动力学模型与控制障碍函数约束投影相结合——通过冲突搜索方法自然扩展至多机器人规划场景。跨仿真实验表明，该集成方法在样本效率、几何平滑度及成功率方面持续优于代表性基线规划器，同时缩短计算时间并生成无碰撞轨迹。

title: StratMamba: Strategic and Reactive Stream Partitioning for Path-Efficient LiDAR-Based Obstacle Avoidance
summary: This paper proposes StratMamba, a dual-stream Mamba-based temporal modeling architecture, to more efficiently capture long-horizon temporal dependencies required for robot navigation in complex and obstacle-rich environments. StratMamba leverages a combination of fast-decay and slow-decay memory architectures, where the fast-decay component processes high-frequency LiDAR data for reactive obstacle avoidance, while the slow-decay component maintains longer-horizon goal information for strategic planning. We perform extensive evaluations of different obstacle avoidance scenarios in IsaacLab and Gazebo, while also validating successful sim-to-real deployment on a Unitree GO1 quadruped robot navigating in the presence of static/dynamic obstacles. Comparisons with other temporal RL baselines, such as LSTM, Transformer, and Vanilla-Mamba, show that our StratMamba achieves exceptional temporal reasoning efficiency with a lower timeout rate, while maintaining the fastest navigation speed (576 median steps, 5.0% better than Vanilla-Mamba). It also achieves the highest path optimality (0.915 path efficiency) across all baselines. Real-world evaluation reveals that StratMamba maintains more robust performance across extended LiDAR ranges compared to vanilla Mamba and the Transformer, demonstrating that dual-stream partitioning effectively balances reactive safety with strategic navigation under challenging sensing conditions.
tldr: StratMamba proposes a dual-stream Mamba architecture with fast-decay and slow-decay memory for LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance, achieving efficient long-horizon temporal reasoning and sim-to-real deployment on a quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: StratMamba提出了一种双流Mamba架构，结合快衰减和慢衰减记忆，用于基于LiDAR的避障，实现了高效的长时域时序推理，并成功在四足机器人上完成仿真到现实的部署。
summary_zh: 本文提出StratMamba——一种基于Mamba的双流时序建模架构，旨在更高效地捕捉机器人在复杂障碍环境中导航所需的长程时间依赖性。StratMamba结合了快衰减与慢衰减两种记忆架构：快衰减组件处理高频激光雷达数据以实现反应式避障，而慢衰减组件则维护用于战略规划的长期目标信息。我们在IsaacLab和Gazebo中针对不同避障场景进行了广泛评估，同时验证了其在宇树GO1四足机器人在静态/动态障碍物环境中导航的成功仿真到现实部署。与LSTM、Transformer和Vanilla-Mamba等其他时序强化学习基线相比，我们的StratMamba以更低的超时率实现了卓越的时序推理效率，同时保持了最快的导航速度（中位步数576，比Vanilla-Mamba提升5.0%），并在所有基线中实现了最高路径最优性（路径效率0.915）。真实环境评估显示，与普通Mamba和Transformer相比，StratMamba在扩展激光雷达范围内保持更稳健的性能，表明双流划分在具有挑战性的感知条件下有效平衡了反应式安全与战略性导航。

title: Contract-Grounded Behavior Tree Synthesis via Coding Agents
summary: Synthesizing deployable robot behavior trees (BTs) from natural language (NL) requires grounding to ensure every generated BT references only skills a robot can actually execute. Existing LLM-based BT synthesis approaches often place this grounding responsibility on the prompt author. This makes deployment brittle when the author does not know which skills the robot can execute, how those skills are parameterized, or how the robot runtime software constrains valid BT structure. This paper proposes a contract-grounded BT synthesis architecture in which a coding agent queries a robot-side Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to retrieve an explicit contract consisting of a skill library, permitted BT operators, and optional BT composition templates, before synthesizing a BT for validation and execution. In our framework, non-expert operators issue NL commands without knowledge of robot implementation details, while a robot runtime validation gate enforces correctness before execution. We evaluate two LLMs, a closed model (Sonnet 4.6) and a smaller open-source model (Gemma4:31b), across 110 simulated tasks in PyRoboSim and 14 tasks on a physical Husarion Panther robot. Results show that contract grounding enables near-perfect BT validation and high task success, that BT composition templates substantially recover success on reactive control-flow tasks for the smaller model, and that the architecture transfers to physical hardware running a Nav2 stack opaque to both operator and agent.
tldr: This paper proposes a contract-grounded architecture where a coding agent queries a robot-side MCP server to retrieve skill libraries and BT templates before synthesizing behavior trees from natural language, achieving near-perfect validation on simulated and physical robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种契约引导的行为树合成架构，编码代理通过查询机器人端MCP服务器获取技能库和模板，在仿真和实体机器人上实现接近完美的验证与高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 从自然语言（NL）综合生成可部署的机器人行为树（BT）需要语义约束，以确保每个生成的BT仅引用机器人实际可执行的技能。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的BT综合方法通常将这一约束责任置于提示编写者身上。当编写者不了解机器人可执行哪些技能、这些技能如何参数化、或机器人运行时软件对有效BT结构的限制时，这种部署方式会变得脆弱。本文提出了一种基于契约约束的BT综合架构，其中编码代理在综合生成BT供验证和执行之前，先查询机器人端的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，获取由技能库、允许的BT运算符和可选的BT组合模板组成的显式契约。在我们的框架中，非专业操作员在不了解机器人实现细节的情况下发出自然语言指令，而机器人运行时验证门在执行前强制执行正确性。我们在PyRoboSim模拟器上的110个任务和物理Husarion Panther机器人上的14个任务中，评估了两种LLM：闭源模型（Sonnet 4.6）和较小的开源模型（Gemma4:31b）。结果表明，契约约束实现了近乎完美的BT验证和较高的任务成功率，BT组合模板显著恢复了较小模型在反应式控制流任务上的成功率，并且该架构可迁移至运行对操作员和代理均不透明的Nav2栈的物理硬件上。

title: Enabling 24-hour Agricultural Robotics: Unsupervised Day-to-Night Cross-Modal Image Translation for Nighttime Visual Navigation
summary: While visual navigation has been extensively studied in agricultural robotics, most existing systems assume daytime conditions. In fact, deploying autonomous robots at night offers significant advantages, including 24-hour crop and soil monitoring, fruit harvesting, and nocturnal pest detection. Modern vision-based systems, however, rely heavily on large-scale well-annotated image datasets, which remains challenging to obtain for nighttime operation scenarios. To address this, we propose an unsupervised image translation framework that converts daytime plant-row RGB images into near-infrared (NIR) nighttime counterparts without requiring pixel-to-pixel supervision. This enables the direct reuse of daytime semantic labels for training nighttime perception models. In particular, by incorporating a pre-trained Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, the proposed framework is designed to preserve semantic consistency during day-to-night translation. Additionally, a visibility mask is introduced to account for the limited effective range of NIR illumination in nighttime scenes. We conduct comparative evaluations with state-of-the-art image translation baselines and demonstrate higher image qualities, as supported by improved performance in downstream semantic segmentation for nighttime visual navigation. For evaluation, we utilize AgriNight--a novel dataset comprising 428 daytime and 549 nighttime images collected using night-vision-equipped mobile robots in agricultural fields and manually annotated with pixel-wise semantic labels--and introduce it as the first benchmark for nighttime agricultural visual navigation. We also perform real-time autonomous navigation experiments with a physical robot operating at night. The data and code are available at: https://github.com/mamorobel/AgriNight.
tldr: Proposes an unsupervised day-to-night image translation framework using CLIP to preserve semantics, enabling nighttime visual navigation for agricultural robots without requiring nighttime labeled data, validated on a novel dataset and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无监督的日间到夜间图像转换框架，借助CLIP保持语义一致性，使得农业机器人无需夜间标注数据即可实现夜间视觉导航，在新数据集和真实机器人实验上得到验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管农业机器人中的视觉导航已被广泛研究，但现有系统大多假设在白天条件下运行。实际上，在夜间部署自主机器人具有显著优势，包括24小时作物与土壤监测、水果采摘以及夜间害虫检测。然而，现代基于视觉的系统高度依赖大规模、标注完善的图像数据集，这在夜间作业场景中仍难以获得。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种无监督图像转换框架，能够在不依赖像素级监督的情况下，将白天的植物行RGB图像转换为近红外（NIR）夜间图像。这使白天语义标签可直接用于训练夜间感知模型。具体而言，通过引入预训练的对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型，该框架被设计为在昼夜转换过程中保持语义一致性。此外，我们还引入了一个可见性掩码，以考虑夜间场景中近红外照明的有限有效范围。我们与最先进的图像转换基线进行了对比评估，结果表明，所提框架生成了更高质量的图像，这在下游夜间视觉导航语义分割任务中的性能提升中得到了验证。在评估中，我们使用了AgriNight——一个包含428张白天图像和549张夜间图像的新数据集，这些图像由配备夜视功能的移动机器人在农田中采集，并附有像素级语义标注——并将其作为夜间农业视觉导航的首个基准数据集。我们还使用实体机器人进行了夜间实时自主导航实验。数据和代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/mamorobel/AgriNight。

title: LARAD: Layout-Aware Road Anomaly Detection via Spatial-Logic Reasoning
summary: Accurate open-world obstacle detection is critical for autonomous driving. Current anomaly segmentation methods suffer from a fundamental blind spot: they over-rely on texture novelty to identify out-of-distribution (OoD) objects while ignoring contextual spatial logic. Furthermore, mitigating the resulting false positives often requires cascading massive vision models, introducing unacceptable inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Layout-Aware Road Anomaly Detection (LARAD), shifting the paradigm from appearance matching to spatial-logic reasoning. First, we introduce the Spatial-Logic Violation Synthesis (SLVS) pipeline, which generates training samples that are texture-consistent yet spatially invalid, forcing the model to learn contextual violations. Second, we augment a standard closed-set segmentation network with a lightweight, OoD-guided attention branch. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LARAD significantly enhances robustness against logical anomalies and establishes a new state-of-the-art, all while retaining the high efficiency of a single-model architecture.
tldr: LARAD proposes a layout-aware road anomaly detection method for autonomous driving that uses spatial-logic reasoning instead of texture novelty, achieving state-of-the-art results with a single efficient model.
tldr_zh: LARAD提出了一种面向自动驾驶的布局感知道路异常检测方法，利用空间逻辑推理替代纹理新颖性，以单一高效模型达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 精准的开放世界障碍物检测对自动驾驶至关重要。当前的异常分割方法存在一个根本性盲区：它们过度依赖纹理新颖性来识别分布外（OoD）物体，却忽略了上下文空间逻辑。此外，为缓解由此产生的误报，往往需要级联大量视觉模型，从而导致难以接受的推理延迟。针对这些问题，我们提出布局感知道路异常检测（LARAD），将范式从外观匹配转向空间逻辑推理。首先，我们引入空间逻辑违反合成（SLVS）流水线，该流水线生成纹理一致但空间无效的训练样本，迫使模型学习上下文违反模式。其次，我们在标准闭集分割网络上增加一个轻量级的OoD引导注意力分支。大量实验表明，LARAD显著增强了对逻辑异常的鲁棒性，在保持单模型架构高效性的同时，确立了新的最优性能水平。

title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
summary: Autonomous UAV systems increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to operate in complex real-world environments. Such embodied scenarios require not only understanding the surrounding space but also maintaining a coherent representation of the agent itself. However, existing UAV-oriented approaches and benchmarks remain largely environment-centric, primarily focusing on spatial understanding tasks, with the agent's self-awareness remaining implicit. To address this gap, we introduce SIS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating embodied spatial intelligence in UAV scenarios under a unified self-in-space formulation. SIS-Bench organizes evaluation along two complementary dimensions, space and self, and a three-level hierarchy of perception, memory, and reasoning. It contains 4,856 question--answer pairs across 13 tasks derived from 1,646 real-world UAV videos through a task-conditioned construction pipeline with expert verification. Extensive evaluations reveal that current MLLMs exhibit fundamental limitations in modeling dynamic and agent-centered processes. In particular, we observe a clear imbalance between spatial cognition and self-awareness, as well as a progressive performance degradation across cognitive levels. Motivated by these findings, we further explore a motion-aware representation that incorporates self-related dynamics through optical flow and visual feature fusion. Experimental results show that modeling agent motion consistently improves perception and memory performance, not only in spatial cognition but also in self-awareness, and generalizes to downstream UAV decision-making tasks. Our results highlight the importance of self-awareness for advancing embodied spatial intelligence, and provide both a new benchmark and empirical evidence for motion-aware self-in-space modeling.
tldr: SIS-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on UAV embodied spatial intelligence, introducing a self-in-space formulation that tests perception, memory, and reasoning. It finds current MLLMs lack self-awareness and dynamic modeling, and shows that motion-aware representations improve both spatial cognition and self-awareness, benefiting downstream UAV decision-making.
tldr_zh: SIS-Bench是一个评估多模态大语言模型在无人机具身空间智能中的基准，提出了“自我在空间中”的框架，测试感知、记忆和推理能力。发现现有MLLMs缺乏自我意识和动态建模，并证明运动感知表示可同时提升空间认知和自我意识，有利于下游无人机决策。
summary_zh: 自主无人机系统日益依赖多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在复杂真实环境中运行。此类具身场景不仅要求理解周围空间，还需维持智能体自身的连贯表征。然而，现有面向无人机的研究方法与基准仍以环境为中心，主要聚焦空间理解任务，智能体的自我意识仍属隐式范畴。为填补这一空白，我们提出SIS-Bench——一个在统一“空间中的自我”框架下评估无人机场景具身空间智能的基准。SIS-Bench沿“空间”与“自我”两个互补维度，以及感知、记忆与推理三个认知层级组织评估体系。该基准通过任务条件化构建流程与专家验证，从1,646段真实无人机视频中衍生出13项任务的4,856个问答对。广泛评估表明，当前多模态大语言模型在建模动态与智能体中心化过程方面存在根本性局限。具体而言，我们观察到空间认知与自我意识之间存在显著失衡，且认知层级间呈现渐进式性能退化。基于这些发现，我们进一步探索通过光流与视觉特征融合来融合自我相关动态的运动感知表征。实验结果表明，对智能体运动进行建模能持续提升感知与记忆性能——不仅在空间认知方面，在自我意识方面同样显著，并能泛化至下游无人机决策任务。我们的研究结果凸显了自我意识对推进具身空间智能的重要性，并为运动感知的“空间中的自我”建模提供了新基准与实证依据。

title: Unveiling Complex Collective Behaviors from Simple Rewards
summary: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) holds great potential for robot swarms, but the black-box nature of neural policies complicates strategic analysis, limiting multi-robot applications. Furthermore, complex swarm behaviors can surprisingly emerge from simple rewards without explicit aggregation incentives. Unveiling the mechanisms behind this emergence is critical, but the disconnection between simple rewards and collective behaviors exacerbates interpretability challenges. This paper aims to reveal the hidden mechanisms in this process. We propose a two-stage EEC (\LinkIII) explanatory framework. This includes a novel analytical tool called the Agent Response Map (ARM), which reveals agents' decision-making patterns across space and identifies regions of aggregation and avoidance. ARM reveals that the robots implicitly learn the geometric fields of the environment and utilize these structures as desired targets for coordinated movement. We validate this finding across two distinct tasks: a cooperative multi-robot shape assembly and a competitive predator-prey pursuit-evasion. 1) In the cooperative task, ARM identifies the unoccupied target interior as the desired destination for robot navigation. As the center becomes occupied, this target region automatically shifts toward the boundary, demonstrating the robots' capacity to autonomously explore unoccupied areas. 2) In the competitive task, ARM surprisingly identifies the boundary of the predators' Voronoi diagram as the convergence destination for prey agents. Together, these two tasks demonstrate the capability of ARM to discover the hidden geometric structures underlying MARL policies in robot swarms.
tldr: This paper introduces an explanatory framework (EEC) and Agent Response Map (ARM) to uncover hidden geometric and structural mechanisms underlying emergent collective behaviors in multi-agent reinforcement learning for robot swarms, validated on cooperative shape assembly and competitive predator-prey tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个解释性框架（EEC）和代理响应图（ARM），用以揭示多智能体强化学习中机器人群体涌现行为的隐藏几何与结构机制，并在协作形状组装和竞争性捕食-逃避任务中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在机器人集群领域具有巨大潜力，但神经策略的"黑箱"特性使得战略分析复杂化，限制了多机器人应用。此外，复杂的集群行为可能从简单的奖励机制中涌现，而无需明确的聚合激励。揭示这种涌现现象背后的机制至关重要，但简单奖励与集体行为之间的脱节加剧了可解释性挑战。本文旨在揭示这一过程中的隐藏机制。我们提出了一种名为EEC（\LinkIII）的两阶段解释框架。该框架包含一种创新分析工具——智能体响应地图（ARM），它能揭示智能体在空间中的决策模式，并识别聚合与避让区域。ARM表明，机器人会隐式学习环境的几何场，并将这些结构作为协调运动的期望目标。我们在两个不同任务中验证了这一发现：协同多机器人形状组装任务与竞争性捕食者-猎物追逃任务。1）在协同任务中，ARM将未占据的目标内部区域识别为机器人导航的期望目的地。随着中心区域被占据，该目标区域自动向边界移动，展现了机器人自主探索未占用区域的能力。2）在竞争任务中，ARM意外地发现捕食者Voronoi图的边界是猎物智能体的汇聚目的地。这两个任务共同证明了ARM在揭示机器人集群中MARL策略隐藏几何结构方面的能力。

title: Directional Constraints for Efficient Exploration in Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning has revolutionized the landscape of robotic research, allowing robust learning of complex robotic skills in simulation. However, real-world deployment in open-ended environments requires strong safety guarantees to prevent dangerous or harmful behaviors. Safe Reinforcement Learning methods address this requirement by enforcing safety constraints. Nevertheless, learning under constraints often reduces learning speed and could lead to suboptimal task performance, as the agent must solve a more complex constrained optimization problem compared to unconstrained settings. To tackle this issue, in this work, we propose an extension of the ATACOM framework, a state-of-the-art reliable safety layer that can be integrated with existing Reinforcement Learning algorithms to enforce constraints derived from prior knowledge of the system or learned directly from data. Our proposed method, named ATACOM Directional Constraints (ATACOM-DC), significantly improves the safety-performance trade-off by introducing directional constraints that distinguish between actions approaching and moving away from constraint boundaries, activating constraint enforcement only when necessary. We evaluate our method across a range of challenging robotic control tasks in simulation, analyzing both constraint-violation costs and achieved task performance. Code and additional material at https://atacom-dc.robot-learning.net.
tldr: This paper extends the ATACOM safety layer for reinforcement learning by introducing directional constraints that only enforce safety when actions move toward constraint boundaries, improving the safety-performance trade-off in simulated robotic control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了ATACOM安全层，通过引入方向性约束，仅在动作趋向约束边界时进行安全干预，从而在仿真机器人控制任务中提升了安全与性能的平衡。
summary_zh: 强化学习已彻底改变机器人研究领域，使机器人能够在仿真环境中稳健学习复杂技能。然而，在开放环境中的真实部署需要强大的安全保障以防止危险或有害行为。安全强化学习方法通过施加安全约束来满足这一需求。但与非约束场景相比，智能体需要解决更复杂的约束优化问题，因此带约束的学习往往会降低学习速度，并可能导致次优的任务性能。为解决这一问题，本文提出ATACOM框架的扩展——这是一种先进的可信赖安全层，可与现有强化学习算法集成，以施加源自系统先验知识或直接从数据中学习的约束。我们提出的方法名为ATACOM方向性约束（ATACOM-DC），通过引入区分趋近与远离约束边界的动作的方向性约束，仅在必要时激活约束强制执行，从而显著改善安全-性能权衡。我们在仿真环境中对一系列具有挑战性的机器人控制任务进行了评估，分析了约束违反成本与任务达成性能。代码及附加资料见https://atacom-dc.robot-learning.net。

title: Globalized Constrained Stein Variational Inference for Diverse Feasible Robot Motion Planning
summary: Robot motion planning is inherently multimodal, yet classical planners typically return only a single solution. Probabilistic formulations address this limitation by maintaining a distribution over motions, allowing the planner to reason over multiple low-cost alternatives. In robotics, however, motion samples must also satisfy strict constraints, including collision avoidance, joint limits, contact conditions, and dynamics consistency. These hard requirements make motion sampling substantially more challenging: within a limited planning budget, the ensemble must cover diverse low-cost motions while ensuring that every sample remains feasible under the relevant constraints. We propose SteinSQP (Stein Variational Sequential Quadratic Programming), a constrained Stein variational inference method for diverse feasible robot motion sampling. SteinSQP evolves an interacting particle ensemble, as in Stein variational methods, while embedding constraints directly into a kernel-space SQP subproblem. We solve the resulting constrained Stein-Newton subproblem with a GPU-friendly matrix-free primal-dual algorithm, enabling efficient batched ensemble updates. To globalize the method, we introduce an ensemble-level merit function that jointly balances objective value, constraint violation, and particle diversity. Across five constrained motion-planning tasks, SteinSQP returns fully feasible ensembles while preserving diverse motion alternatives. Compared with first-order constrained Stein baselines and serial multistart nonlinear programming, SteinSQP shows faster and more robust ensemble convergence in terms of iterations, improves particle-wise feasibility, and achieves faster batched time-to-solution on challenging robot-scale tasks.
tldr: SteinSQP combines Stein variational inference with sequential quadratic programming to generate diverse, constraint-satisfying motion plans for robots, achieving faster and more robust ensemble convergence than prior methods.
tldr_zh: SteinSQP 将斯坦变分推断与序列二次规划相结合，为机器人生成多样且满足约束的运动规划，在集成收敛速度和鲁棒性上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 机器人运动规划本质上是多模态的，然而经典规划器通常只返回单一解。概率化公式通过维持运动分布的表示来应对这一局限，使规划器能够推理多个低成本备选方案。但在机器人领域，运动样本还必须满足严格约束，包括碰撞规避、关节限位、接触条件及动力学一致性。这些硬性要求使运动采样更具挑战性：在有限的规划预算内，样本集合必须覆盖多样化的低成本运动，同时确保每个样本在相关约束下保持可行性。我们提出SteinSQP（斯坦变分序列二次规划），这是一种用于多样化可行机器人运动采样的约束斯坦变分推断方法。SteinSQP在演化粒子相互作用集合时（与斯坦变分方法相同），将约束直接嵌入核空间的SQP子问题中。我们采用GPU友好的无矩阵原始-对偶算法求解约束斯坦-牛顿子问题，从而实现高效的批量化集合更新。为全局化该方法，我们引入集合级评价函数，共同平衡目标值、约束违反度与粒子多样性。在五个约束运动规划任务中，SteinSQP在保持运动备选多样性的同时返回完全可行的样本集合。与一阶约束斯坦基线及串行多起点非线性规划相比，SteinSQP在迭代次数上展现出更快且更稳健的集合收敛性，改善了粒子级可行性，并在具有挑战性的机器人规模任务中实现了更快的批量化求解时间。

title: Infra-Swarm: Robust Vision-Based Multi-Robot Swarming via Near-Infrared Spectral Vision
summary: Distributed swarms typically rely on either active wireless communication or passive vision, and they are frequently hindered by bandwidth constraints or environmental sensitivity. This paper proposes Infra-Swarm, a robust vision-based swarm. Each robot is equipped with a near-infrared light source and four ordinary gray-scale cameras. The Infra-Swarm system directly measures the centimeter-level 3D position of neighbors based on the position (bearing) and intensity (strength) of optical flares in the captured images. By utilizing 940 nm narrow-band filters to physically reject 99.2% of ambient light interference, the perception front-end achieves hardware-level robustness against illumination variations. Furthermore, its minimal computational overhead provides a resilient foundation for the massive scalability of robotic collectives on resource-constrained hardware.
tldr: Infra-Swarm presents a multi-robot swarming system that uses near-infrared spectral vision with optical flare detection for robust, centimeter-level 3D neighbor localization, offering hardware-level ambient light rejection and minimal computation for scalable swarms.
tldr_zh: Infra-Swarm 提出了一种基于近红外光谱视觉的多机器人集群系统，通过检测光斑实现厘米级三维邻居定位，硬件级过滤环境光干扰，计算开销低，适用于可扩展的机器人集群。
summary_zh: 分布式集群通常依赖于主动无线通信或被动视觉感知，但两者常受限于带宽约束或环境敏感性。本文提出Infra-Swarm——一种鲁棒的视觉集群系统。每台机器人配备近红外光源及四枚普通灰度相机。Infra-Swarm系统通过捕获图像中光斑的位置（方位角）与强度（能量值）直接测量邻居机器人的厘米级三维坐标。通过采用940纳米窄带滤光片物理阻隔99.2%的环境光干扰，其感知前端在硬件层面实现了对光照变化的强鲁棒性。此外，该方案极低的计算开销为资源受限硬件上大规模机器人集群的扩展提供了弹性基础。

title: DiffRadar: Differentiable Physics-Aware Radar SLAM with Gaussian Fields
summary: Radar sensing is increasingly used in mobile systems because it operates reliably under poor lighting, adverse weather, and privacy-sensitive settings where cameras and LiDAR often fail. However, most existing radar SLAM systems estimate motion through scan matching on discretized radar heatmaps, which breaks geometric continuity and fails to capture key radar sensing properties, often leading to unstable pose estimation and degraded mapping in regenerate or dynamically changing environments. We present DiffRadar, a real-time radar SLAM system that models radar observations as a differentiable, physics-aware Gaussian field rather than discrete scans. DiffRadar represents the scene as anisotropic Gaussian primitives and renders radar measurements in range-azimuth and Doppler-azimuth spaces through a differentiable radar forward model, enabling joint optimization of robot pose and scene structure directly from radar measurements. We implement DiffRadar on commodity FMCW radar hardware and evaluate it on both the public Radarize benchmark and a controlled stress-test suite that targets common radar SLAM failure modes, including corridor degeneracy, motion regime transitions, dynamic clutter, and long-horizon loop closures. DiffRadar achieves substantial reductions in trajectory error on the benchmark, with especially large gains under feature-poor corridor motion, while more than doubling map consistency and maintaining real-time performance at 70 FPS. These results show that modeling radar observations directly in the signal domain enables substantially more robust and consistent radar-only SLAM for mobile platforms.
tldr: DiffRadar is a real-time radar SLAM system that models radar observations as a differentiable, physics-aware Gaussian field, enabling joint optimization of robot pose and scene structure and achieving large trajectory error reductions and doubled map consistency.
